scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/migrate-and-seed.js && next build
scripts.backup: mkdir -p backups && /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin/pg_dump -d wedding_dev -f backups/dev-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H%M).sql && ( mkdir -p "$HOME/Documents/Wed/wedding-backups" && cp backups/dev-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H%M).sql "$HOME/Documents/Wed/wedding-backups/" && echo 'Backed up locally and to iCloud.' ) || echo 'Backed up locally. (iCloud copy skipped.)'
